patterns.note: Extensive use of detailed product mockups and UI screenshots directly integrated into the page design to visually explain features and benefits, rather than relying solely on abstract icons or text.
A strong brand identity established through a dominant dark green and a vibrant lime green accent, used consistently for backgrounds, CTAs, and key visual elements.
Feature sections are presented with an accordion-style list on one side, dynamically updating a corresponding animated product mockup or screenshot on the other side as the user interacts.
The hero section's product mockups parallax upwards against the background gradient as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth and revealing more of the background.
A cookie consent banner slides up from the bottom left corner of the screen as the user scrolls down the page, providing a clear, non-intrusive notification.
Alternating background colors (dark green, white, light grey) are used to clearly delineate major content sections and provide visual rhythm down the page.

technique_notes: The site uses a scroll-based animation library (likely locomotive-scroll) to orchestrate various visual effects, including parallax and element reveals.
Sections and individual content blocks are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic browsing experience.
The hero section features a multi-layered parallax effect where product mockups move at a different speed than the background gradient, adding depth and visual interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, establishing a clear hierarchy, with smaller, often uppercase, labels used for sub-headings or feature titles.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., ~4-8px) on buttons, input fields, cards, and the cookie banner, providing a soft, approachable feel without being fully rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with an airy hero section that transitions to a more dense but still legible layout for feature grids and footer links.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its heavy reliance on high-fidelity product mockups and UI screenshots, integrated directly into the page to visually demonstrate the software's capabilities. This approach goes beyond typical abstract icons, offering a tangible preview of the user experience and making the platform's value immediately clear.
